title: While a cloud save is held undrawn, the erase guard's epoch reads nil: keep the landed record's erase epoch apart from its drawing
evidence: Found by Codex on PR 1728 (H17, R1), accepted there. Screen.epoch and Mark.epoch read heldData?.eraseEpoch, and heldData is drawn?.myData (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore+Source.swift ~:141, RecordStore+Mark.swift ~:21, RecordStore+Readable.swift ~:57), so once a cloud edit or document save lands held undrawn they are nil. A lab review pinned before the hold (LabReportSave.swift ~:204) then fails shows(seen) and mark.holds: its values save, the original is refused with 'record changed', and save-all stops at the next report. Fix: store the landed record's eraseEpoch in land(), separate from the drawing. Erase class: design note first, then adversary + Codex; needs a test with a pinned lab review, its original, then a second report.
